name: Saifai
limitations: Bounded eight-dimension review, all main judgments unknown, not low scores or exclusion. Clinical/district observations are not whole-area rates. Free first24h emergency care and eligible PMJAY coverage do not settle ordinary residents subsequent necessary-treatment payment. All candidates retained.

dimensions.rationale: Real regional heat and delivered responses plus flood history and local reference-rock seismic exposure are informative, but principal-hazard exposure/protection has not been connected to the frozen4km2 area.
dimensions.assumption: A60 judgment needs credible local major-hazard protection/low exposure and ordinary reach/continuity;40 needs an important unmitigated hazard. Neither is presently established.

subpillarEvidence.heat_humidity: Etawah站2024热浪5日、45.4°C；县内实际控制室、修手泵、ORS等，Saifai触达及室内／劳动保护未闭。
subpillarEvidence.flood_sea_level: 1998–2020卫星洪水图册的Etawah汇总不是8299淹没；排水／居民恢复未核，海平面直接暴露不由内陆名称独判。
subpillarEvidence.geophysical: 参考岩石PGA0.08439255g；地下水报告的冲积层及下降水位不测建筑抗震、地面沉降或滑坡失效。
subpillarEvidence.severe_weather_wildfire: 热应对不能替雷电、强对流、烟霾与野火；一般医院消防招聘不作灾害失败。

dimensions.rationale: No assigned UCDP events are not zero organised harm. Local effects, regional spillover and strategic-route impact are unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Do not infer60 from silence or40 from national reputation; require actual locally applicable impact and mitigation.

subpillarEvidence.organized_violence: UCDP2021–25与2026 clear/pending归属0，不测所有组织伤害；普通犯罪、抗议或病患纠纷不自动计入。
subpillarEvidence.regional_conflict: 未取得地区冲突到本区居民／资源／交通的实际影响链，不由全国战争语义定档。
subpillarEvidence.strategic_exposure: 旧库无区内机场点不测目标风险；机场目录、政治人物关联和城市名声均不是实际威胁或缓解。

dimensions.rationale: Hospital administration, extended service hours and district heat response show scoped execution. They do not establish local cross-service delivery, group remedies or recovery.
dimensions.assumption: Usual service operation may support60 with local delivery/remedy evidence; persistent important constraints can support40. One hospital instruction cannot represent whole-area governance.

subpillarEvidence.governance: 2026门诊服务时段原令、2025PMJAY实际会纪及责任分派；指令不是已完成患者赔付／资金兑付。
subpillarEvidence.adaptive_capacity: 2024县级24h热控制室、手泵修理、全469GP讨论；覆盖和延续推定须明确，未证明局地多危害适应充分。
subpillarEvidence.social_cohesion: 院讯多信仰空间、性别敏感活动、弱势服务可作局部入口；无居民信任／互助或排斥及实际救济结果。
subpillarEvidence.emergency_recovery: 首24h免费急救存在；不是灾后水电、居住、补偿或家庭恢复的结果。

dimensions.rationale: Block-office handpump tables disagree on manganese; declining monitoring wells and heat response do not measure current delivered household water. Food, energy and supply continuity remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Do not select the worse contradictory table to assign40, or the resource Safe category to assign60. Need actual suitable supply and ordinary affordability with remaining constraints.

subpillarEvidence.water: 2021各block office手泵样本、两个监测井与水位下降；Mn摘表3与原汇总0.039冲突，非2026全户水。
subpillarEvidence.food: 2018–19 SAM住院样本不是本区营养患病率；院方免费餐仅宣布，不能作已交付食品保障。
subpillarEvidence.energy: 未获得实际居民供电／费用和替代供应；旧地下电缆建设／招标不能代可靠性。
subpillarEvidence.supply_chain: AMRIT药房MOU、耗材／药物采购入口和包内支出规则不代已到药、库存与替代供应结果。

dimensions.rationale: Actual routine surgery, emergency first24h support, outpatient and specialist entry exist. PMJAY eligibility and post-initial necessary-treatment affordability for the ordinary median-income resident are not connected; old selected clinical cohorts have limited usual-quality representativeness.
dimensions.assumption: MED60 is an explicit additional hypothesis if usual effective insurance/equivalent public subsidy makes subsequent necessary treatment affordable, observed care reasonably represents continuing appropriate care and referral is usable. These links remain unresolved, so main score is null; old LAMA is not itself current poor quality.

subpillarEvidence.access: 医院点在8299；Oct3原令门诊延时、2025Q4免费首24h急救／VirtualOPD；PMJAY适格及后续支付未闭。
subpillarEvidence.routine_quality: 150人2023–24择期胆囊手术焦虑试验；100名2018–19 SAM儿童53出院/24DOPR/15LAMA/8死亡，非一般风险调整质量。
subpillarEvidence.specialist_capacity: 择期腹腔镜护理、儿科SAM、院方2025首次踝关节镜；专科菜单／院讯量不保证普通必要专科及时获得。
subpillarEvidence.system_continuity: OPD午餐轮值50%在岗、PMJAY夜间经办关闭但急诊首24h检查免费；未核后续治疗及备援。

dimensions.rationale: Other clinical research and ethics-approved trial directories do not establish a suitable healthspan intervention with human outcomes, actual local adoption and resident payment/monitoring.
dimensions.assumption: Need a specific credible pathway; absence of found treatment does not establish40 or0. Same disease-pathway rules as other cities apply.

subpillarEvidence.translation: 常规手术焦虑干预、SAM和COPD／疫苗登记不自动构成健康寿命转化路径。
subpillarEvidence.trial_maturity: 2023–24伦理批准6项PhaseIII/IV目录，无在本地实际纳入、完成、结果和健康寿命适配。
subpillarEvidence.regulatory_adoption: 伦理号不是药品采用批准；未闭具体干预—适应证—监管—本地实施。
subpillarEvidence.resident_access: PMJAY普通医疗经办和免费急救不能替目标转化干预的适用者／支付／监护。

dimensions.rationale: Actual research, funding, selected network samples and a started virtual outpatient service are partial capabilities. Sustained industry application and resident diffusion are not established.
dimensions.assumption: Need a credible knowledge/industry/infrastructure/adoption connection for60; unknown firms are not a proven40 constraint and fast samples do not imply80.

subpillarEvidence.knowledge_output: 2025原RCT、2022观察研究及2023–24资助／项目原表；出版累计数不是全球比较分。
subpillarEvidence.industry_density: MOU和招标不证明本区持续产业实际生产、采用、替代节点；不是已证产业不存在。
subpillarEvidence.digital_infrastructure: Q32026固定125次／10瓦片，移动147次／8瓦片，条件下载113.7／191.7Mbps；非普及或可靠性。
subpillarEvidence.diffusion: Dec2025院方报告VirtualOPD已启动，AI培训／科研展示亦存在；不能从启动推广泛居民采用和获益。

dimensions.rationale: A railway actually opened in2016, national application/transfer rules and network samples exist. Current physical alternatives, usually executable migration and shared-failure continuity remain unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: Current usable transport plus ordinary legal, financial and network applicability is needed for60. An outside-area airport or absent directory point is not a proven40 restriction.

subpillarEvidence.transport_redundancy: Railways2016确已开通并给Saifai halt时刻；不是2026可靠性／当前班次，城外设施也不因出界自动不可用。
subpillarEvidence.legal_mobility: Passport Seva原办理流程需文件／预约／视核验类型；不当目的地居留或本地处理成功率。
subpillarEvidence.asset_portability: RBI2024更新LRS允许居民个人每财年USD250k许可交易，PAN/FormA2/KYC及限制仍适用；不是可用财富／零税费。
subpillarEvidence.network_continuity: fixed/mobile同时有测试不证明独立底层备援，未核中断后连接与资源转移。

webReadSources.scope: Web-only procedure, not current fee or successful applications

referencePoints.label: UPUMS official website embedded map reference
referencePoints.qualification: directory reference point; not hospital footprint or every treatment site

conditions: Target usual resident has effective PMJAY or equivalent/subsidy that makes post-24h necessary treatment affordable
Observed selected clinical care reasonably represents usual appropriate care and continues to cutoff
Necessary specialist referral is usable under the target conditions

minimumReopen: FUA-specific heat/flood/weather exposure and delivered protection/residual result
Ordinary target eligibility and post-initial-emergency necessary treatment payment/quality path
Suitable healthspan intervention human result/local adoption/access chain

boundedReview.stop: two bounded directed rounds; no repetitive same-page search
